t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Color of gnomes doesn't matter. Size of hats matters. Once getting a large amount of mushrooms, click the gnome on opposite side as last time.

vb_textbox.text: The color of the gnomes hats does not matter. The size of the hat does. The larger the hat, the large the amount of mushrooms you get next round. If hats are the same size, choose the option opposite of what you picked the previous round.
